description: Upcoming token unlocks from the tokens' emissions schedules, updated daily: per token and unlock moment, the cliff tokens released, the net change of linear vesting (tokens a week), the allocations (team, investors, airdrop, ...), the value in USD at the token's latest price and the share of its circulating supply, 50 per page. Filter by days ahead, allocation category, a minimum USD value or one token; sort by date or value. Schedules are taken as published; a team's 'unlock' may vest per person rather than reach the market at once. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

category.description: Only the allocations of this category (insiders = team and advisors, privateSale = investors).

days.description: How many days ahead, from now.

min_value_usd.description: The smallest unlock value in USD to list (unlocks of tokens without a price drop out above 0).

sort_by.description: date for the soonest first, value for the largest first.

token.description: One token: its AlphaGrowth project slug (find_projects gives it).

name: token_unlocks
title: Token unlock calendar
